explanation: Heating ammonium cyanate rearranges it into urea — Friedrich Wohler's 1828 synthesis, the experiment that disproved the idea that organic compounds could only be made by living things.

beaker_view.final_appearance: White urea crystals — visually almost unchanged.
beaker_view.observation: Heating the white crystals rearranges them into equally white urea crystals — the visual change is minimal; what made this experiment historic was what it proved, not what it looked like.
